dimensionClamp.meaning: Each dimension has minimum 4 mm; numeric 0/NaN falls back to 10 mm.

colorClamp.meaning: Hue retained; saturation capped at 0.48; lightness constrained to [0.14,0.62]. Colors are selected in handwritten template code.

cadOperations.meaning: Fixed source-expression generator, skipped for normal family_proxy specs.

readyToGeneratingFailure.meaning: Normal mechanical records are ready before browser requests generating; transition rejects with HTTP409, confirmed in runtime audit.

soil-pump: Screenshot shows a horizontal barrel with a separated rim/cap cue and a disconnected straight rectangular tube proxy.
Graph has no fluid relationships and assembly has no mechanical mates; all auxiliary parts receive semantic_support placement and no reported physical limitations.
Container branch uses default-Y-axis CylinderGeometry with zero rotation despite scene Z-up, offsets cylinder center by h/2 along Z, and separately offsets rim/cap along Z (WorkspaceApp.tsx:92).
Tube has no dedicated renderer branch and falls through to rounded-box renderer (WorkspaceApp.tsx:96).
solar-tracker: Screenshot shows three LDR modules and resistor/wire cues extending right of the base.
Of four LDR sensors, only component-light-sensor has a panel graph mate; remaining three have no mechanical parent and use semantic_support placement.
The three unmatched sensors have center X=167.9/211.9/255.9 mm while the 150 mm wide base is centered X=0, so none is positioned over its cited support footprint.
Planner connects only sensors[0] to platforms[0] (planner/service.py:414); auxiliary placement follows assembly.py:166-199.

sourceVsBundleObservation.limit: Literal absence is evidence of a possible source/build mismatch; it alone does not certify the bundle source revision.
